notes.title: Quick Patch
notes.content:
Hello,

A quick extra update to patch a few important bugs that were reported on our discord:

-fixed being on unable to enter dungeons on some generations
-fixed loading text not disappearing through playthrough even once loaded
-fixed being unable to select first row items precisely
-Improved pathfinding
-fixed some crashes

Cheers

notes.title: Quick Patch
notes.content:
Quick extra patch to fix some bugs:
-Fixed bug sometimes preventing joining online game in the lobby
-Fixed a bug where multiplayer games can crash/freeze at start
-Fixed fog distance being too far in multiplayer
-Fixed terrain grass not appearing when you restart the game
-Fixed some crashes

notes.title: Update #006 - New Level & more!
notes.content:
Hello

We have released a new content update! This update adds a new surface map and some bug fixes. The map can be selected on the character menu when starting a game.

-New Map: The Alps - Go camping in the snowy Alps mountains. A blizzard sweeps up in the night! 
-New Enemy native to the Alps
-Tweaked global fog to be more immersive
-Fixed some enemy AI bugs causing pathfinding/damage errors
-Fixed a bug where some melee weapons were not causing damage
-Improved the cloud and sky visuals
-New ambient SFXs
-Fixed multiple lighting and shadow issues
-Minor bug fixes (typos, visual etc)

Another update will be out again soon. Next update we will add some new items, tools, and weapons along with the regular bug fixes and tweaks.

Cheers!

notes.title: Update #005
notes.content:
Hello

We have released update number five, patching more bugs.

Changelog: 
-Adjusted and rebalancing of enemy stamina and speed
-better pathfinding for enemies
-increased item spawn rates (more items)
-slight changes and improvements to inventory GUI
-Adjusted distance at which distant lights such as campfires etc can be seen
-Fixed a big bug where sometimes active online games were not appearing in online lobbies (or only one at a time)
-Fixed a bug where empty online games (one that all players leave) can still be shown in the lobby
-Fixed a lobby bug preventing you from joining some games with the error message it is full
-Fixed a bug where the lobby rooms are not updating in real time, for example, you see a room in the lobby and if a new player joins it the current players in that room would not update for you unless you left and manually refreshed
-Slight GUI changes to multiplayer layout
-Fixed a bug where player UI sometimes disappears when unpausing

Cheers

notes.title: Update #004
notes.content:
Hello,

We've released another update. This update fixes some issues and gameplay balancing.

-Increased overall weapon durability
-Increased the number of structures that spawn such as campfires, watchtowers, radio towers etc
-Increased item spawn rate and chance at structures
-Increased item spawn rate and amount while underground
-Adjusted enemy chase scream sound effect
-Improved voice chat sound quality
-Some more minor bug fixes/tweaks (typo, graphical/UI bugs etc)


Cheers!

notes.title: Update #003 - Optimization Improvements
notes.content:
Hello,

Another quick update aimed at improving general performance.

-Most should experience generally higher frame rates
-Fixed some crashes occurring
-Fixed some freezes that can occur
-Fixed some other misc bugs (typos, graphic/texture bugs, etc)
-Slightly reduced the size of the overall surface (forest map) as it is presently far too big making it easy to get lost or confused (An option may be added in the future to set a custom size if you want it bigger)
-Reduced lag on menus + main menu
-Fixed leaderboards back button not closing leaderboards if frozen


The next few updates we will focus on more polish, optimization, cleaning up some bugs, and then focus more on additional game content!

Cheers

notes.title: Update #0002
notes.content:
Hello

Another quick update:

Changes:
-Some Optimization improvements
-Improved optimization on the main menu (main menu was lagging)
-Improved visual fog, made it more dense also so you cannot spot enemies from long range and see as far into the distance
-Lockpicked doors will now remove completely to prevent them sometimes getting stuck or obstructing other paths
-Different weapons have different durability changes, i.e branches will not last as long as a shovel
-Fixed a bug where settings sometimes reset
-Improved the clouds with dynamic skybox
-Fixed a bug where whether or not you saved your friend would not load between data
-Improved grass draw distance without cost to performance

Cheers!

notes.title: Quick Update
notes.content:
A very quick extra update fixing a few things:

-Improved optimization of trees/grass further
-Fixed another bug with load items disappearing
-Fixed FPS setting not changing FPS on some machines
-added some anti-cheat protection

notes.title: Update #001
notes.content:
Hello,

We have released a new update!

Changes:
-Fixed golf club duplicating when dropped
-Added an option to delete save files
-Fixed the last three inventory slots not working
-Fixed energy drink not removing if you use it at max health but still restoring stamina
-Fixed a bug causing some items to disappear on reloading
-Some optimization changes for terrain grass
-Forest is slightly darker as it was a bit too bright

There will be another update again soon!

Cheers
